scope: One independently implemented AVX-512 forward-transform primitive; two complete warm JPEG encode screens, same existing original 513x259 RGBA8 raster and frozen matched pair. No new input, preparation or quality enumeration.

quietnessBefore.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

retainedBaseline.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent JPEG bytes: explicit single-round alpha flattening on 0x204060, full-range BT.601 conversion, 4:4:4 encode, output acquisition/release. Native codec/conversion/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused, but pixels are flattened/converted and encoded every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray. Native optimal Huffman and managed fixed Huffman recorded. Quality matched by frozen <=0.25 dB RGB source-error band; fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.

jit.interpretation: Both compilation contexts retain coefficient-bit and admission controls. Hoisting the bounded basis access before accumulator initialization retains all eight accumulators in registers in both observed compilation contexts. The prior unhoisted source had two JIT forms and unstable screens; retain both prior observations. No timing claim follows from instruction counts.

failedPreRunWithoutBenchmarkChild.error: AssertionError('Preserve failed quiet sample and wait.')

unhoistedTrial.interpretation: The repeat erased most of the first-screen gain. Two compilation forms showed different spill behavior. This evidence motivated hoisting the bounded basis before accumulator lifetime; it does not prove which JIT form ran in each timed child.

uncertainty: These narrow screens establish a useful complete-operation gain, not uniform parity certification. Both means remain above 2x. Preserve failed pre/post quietness and all original samples. Other measured gaps, unknown and unmatched directions remain open.
nextPrimitive: PNG decode RGBA16/8 remains the largest measured gap at 2.36/2.33x. Profile the retained RGBA16 warm case once, then change one inflation or row primitive using the same narrow bounds; do not repeat rejected lookup candidates.
